description: You can now use the REST API to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, agent apps, and organizations. What’s new GET and PATCH endpoints are now… The post Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: You can now use the REST API to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, agent apps, and organizations. Enterprise policies can delegate model control to organizations in organization mode, or to teams and apps in enterprise teams mode.
takeaways: The post Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
Reference our documentation on managing availability of models in your enterprise and our REST API documentation to get started.
Enterprise policies can delegate model control to organizations in organization mode, or to teams and apps in enterprise teams mode.
